cues.en: The mathematics we learn in school doesn't quite do the field of mathematics justice.
cues.zh: 我们在学校学的数学，并不能完全展现数学这门学科的全貌。

cues.en: We only get a glimpse at one corner of it but mathematics as a whole is a huge and wonderfully diverse subject.
cues.zh: 我们只看到它的一个角落，但数学整体是一门庞大而极其多样的学科。

cues.en: My aim with this video is to show you all of that amazing stuff.
cues.zh: 这个视频的目的，就是把这些精彩内容都展示给你。

cues.en: We'll start back at the very beginning. The origin of mathematics lies in counting. In fact counting is not just a human trait, other animals are able to count as well.
cues.zh: 我们从最开始讲起。数学的起源在于计数。事实上，计数不只是人类的特性，其他动物也会计数。

cues.en: And evidence for human counting goes back to prehistoric
cues.zh: 而人类计数的证据可以追溯到史前

cues.en: times with check marks made in bones.
cues.zh: 时期，当时人们在骨头上留下刻痕。

cues.en: There were several innovations over the years with the Egyptians having the first equation, the ancient Greeks making strides in many areas like geometry and numerology,
cues.zh: 多年来有过不少创新：埃及人有了第一个方程，古希腊人在几何和数秘学等多个领域取得进展，

cues.en: and negative numbers were invented in China, and zero as a number was first used in India.
cues.zh: 而负数是在中国发明的，零作为一个数字最早在印度使用。

cues.en: Then in the golden age of Islam Persian mathematicians made further strides and the first book on algebra was written.
cues.zh: 随后在伊斯兰黄金时代，波斯数学家又取得进一步进展，写出了第一本代数著作。

cues.en: Then mathematics boomed in the renaissance along with the sciences.
cues.zh: 然后数学在文艺复兴时期随科学一起繁荣起来。

cues.en: Now there is a lot more to the history of mathematics than what I have said but I am going to jump to the modern age and mathematics as we know it now.
cues.zh: 数学史当然远不止我讲的这些，但我要直接跳到现代，也就是我们现在所认识的数学。

cues.en: Modern mathematics can broadly be broken down into two areas.
cues.zh: 现代数学大致可以分为两个领域。

cues.en: Pure maths, the study of mathematics for its own sake and applied maths, when you develop mathematics to help solve some real world problem.
cues.zh: 纯数学，是为数学本身而研究数学；应用数学，则是为了帮助解决现实问题而发展数学。

cues.en: But there is a lot of crossover,
cues.zh: 但两者之间有很多交叉，

cues.en: in fact many times in history someone has gone off into the mathematical wilderness motivated
cues.zh: 事实上，历史上有很多次，有人走进数学的荒野，动机

cues.en: purely by curiosity and guided
cues.zh: 纯粹是好奇心，指引他们的

cues.en: by a sense of aesthetics,
cues.zh: 是一种审美感，

cues.en: And then they've created a whole bunch of new mathematics
cues.zh: 然后他们创造了一大堆新的数学，

cues.en: which is nice and interesting but it doesn't really do anything useful.
cues.zh: 这很好很有趣，但并没有什么实际用处。

cues.en: But then, say one hundred years later, someone will be working on some problem at the cutting edge of physics or computer science, they will discover that this old theory in pure maths is exactly what they need to solve their real world problems.
cues.zh: 但后来，比如一百年后，有人会在物理学或计算机科学的前沿研究某个问题，他们会发现这门纯数学中的旧理论正是他们解决现实问题所需要的。

cues.en: Which is amazing I think. And this kind of thing has happened so many times over the last few centuries, it's interesting how often something so abstract ends up being really useful.
cues.zh: 我觉得这很神奇。过去几个世纪里这种事发生过很多次，有趣的是，如此抽象的东西最终往往非常有用。

cues.en: But I should also mention that pure mathematics on its own is still a very valuable thing to do because it can be fascinating
cues.zh: 但我也应该提到，纯数学本身仍然是非常有价值的事，因为它可以很迷人，

cues.en: and on its own can have a real
cues.zh: 而且它本身可以具有真正的

cues.en: beauty and elegance that almost becomes like art.
cues.zh: 美感和优雅，几乎变得像艺术一样。

cues.en: Okay enough of this hyperluting,
cues.zh: 好了，这种铺垫够多了，

cues.en: let's get into it. Pure maths is made of several sections.
cues.zh: 我们开始吧。纯数学由几个部分构成。

cues.en: The study of numbers starts with the natural numbers and what you can do with them with arithmetic operations,
cues.zh: 对数的研究从自然数开始，以及用算术运算对它们能做什么，

cues.en: and then it looks at other kinds of numbers like integers which contain negative numbers, rational numbers like fractions,
cues.zh: 然后它研究其他种类的数，比如包含负数的整数、像分数这样的有理数、

cues.en: real numbers which include numbers like pi which go off to infinite decimal points,
cues.zh: 包含像 pi 这样有无限小数位的数的实数，

cues.en: and then complex numbers and a whole bunch of others.
cues.zh: 然后是复数以及一大堆其他数。

cues.en: Some numbers have interesting properties like prime numbers or pi or the exponential.
cues.zh: 有些数字有有趣的性质，比如质数、圆周率或指数。

cues.en: There are also properties of these number systems,
cues.zh: 这些数制也有一些特性，

cues.en: for example even though there is infinite
cues.zh: 比如，尽管存在无限

cues.en: amount of both integers and real numbers
cues.zh: 整数和实数的数量

cues.en: there are more real numbers than integers.
cues.zh: 实数比整数多。

cues.en: So some infinities are bigger than others.
cues.zh: 所以有些无穷比其他的更大。

cues.en: The study of structures is where you start taking numbers and putting them into equations in the form of variables.
cues.zh: 结构研究就是你开始把数字以变量形式代入方程的地方。

cues.en: Algebra contains the rules of how you then manipulate these equations.
cues.zh: 代数包含了随后如何变换这些方程的规则。

cues.en: Here you will also find vectors and matrices which are multi dimensional numbers and the rules of how they relate to each other are captured in linear algebra.
cues.zh: 这里你还会看到向量和矩阵，它们是多维的数，而它们之间相互关系的规则由线性代数描述。

cues.en: Number theory studies the features of everything in the last section on numbers like the properties of prime numbers.
cues.zh: 数论研究上一节中与数字有关的一切特征，比如素数的性质。

cues.en: Combinatorics
cues.zh: 组合数学

cues.en: looks at the properties of certain structures like trees, graphs and other things that are made of discrete chunks that you can count.
cues.zh: 研究树、图等结构的性质，以及其他由可计数的离散块构成的东西。

cues.en: Group theory looks at objects that are related to each other in groups.
cues.zh: 群论研究的是以群的形式相互关联的对象。

cues.en: A familiar example is a Rubik's cube which is an example of a permutation group.
cues.zh: 一个熟悉的例子是魔方，它是置换群的一个例子。

cues.en: An order theory investigates how to arrange objects following certain rules like how something is a larger quantity than something else. The natural numbers are an example of an ordered set of objects, but anything with any two way relationship can be ordered.
cues.zh: 序理论研究的，是如何按特定规则排列对象，比如一个事物在数量上如何大于另一个。自然数就是有序对象集的一个例子，但只要事物之间具有双向关系，就可以进行排序。

cues.en: Another part of pure mathematics looks at shapes and how they behave in spaces.
cues.zh: 纯数学还有一个分支研究形状及其在空间中的行为。

cues.en: The origin is in geometry which includes pythagoras and is close to trigonometry which I am sure we are all familiar with from school.
cues.zh: 它起源于几何学，包括毕达哥拉斯，并与三角学密切相关，相信大家从学校起就很熟悉了。

cues.en: Also there are fun things like fractal geometry which are mathematical patterns which are scale invariant
cues.zh: 还有一些有趣的东西，比如分形几何，它是一种具有尺度不变性的数学模式，

cues.en: meaning you can zoom into them forever and they always look kind of the same. Topology looks at different properties of spaces where you are allowed to continuously deform them but not tear or glue them.
cues.zh: 意思是你可以无限放大，它们看起来总是差不多。拓扑学研究空间的不同性质，允许连续变形，但不能撕裂或粘合。

cues.en: For example a mobius strip has only one surface and one edge whatever you do to it, and coffee cups and donuts are the same thing topologically speaking.
cues.zh: 例如，莫比乌斯带无论怎么处理，都只有一个面和一个边缘；而拓扑学上，咖啡杯和甜甜圈是同一回事。

cues.en: Measure theory is a way to assign values to spaces or sets,
cues.zh: 测度论是一种为空间或集合赋值的方法，

cues.en: tying together numbers and spaces.
cues.zh: 把数和空间联系起来。

cues.en: And finally differential geometry looks at the properties of shapes on curved surfaces, for example triangles have got different angles on a curved surface,
cues.zh: 最后，微分几何研究曲面上的形状性质，例如曲面上的三角形内角不同，

cues.en: and brings us to the next section which is changes.
cues.zh: 这就把我们带到下一部分：变化。

cues.en: The study of changes contains calculus which involves integrals and differentials
cues.zh: 变化的研究包含微积分，涉及积分和微分，

cues.en: which looks at the area spanned out by functions or the behaviour of gradients of functions,
cues.zh: 研究函数所覆盖的面积或函数梯度的行为，

cues.en: and vector calculus looks at the same thing but for vectors.
cues.zh: 向量微积分研究同样的事情，但针对向量。

cues.en: Here we also find a bunch of other areas like dynamical systems which looks at systems that evolve in time from one state to another like fluid flows or things with feedback loops like ecosystems,
cues.zh: 这里我们还会发现其他一些领域，比如动力系统，研究随时间从一个状态演化到另一个状态的系统，如流体流动或带反馈回路的事物，比如生态系统，

cues.en: and chaos theory which studies dynamical systems that are very sensitive to initial conditions.
cues.zh: 还有混沌理论，研究对初始条件非常敏感的动力系统。

cues.en: Finally complex analysis looks at the properties of functions with complex numbers.
cues.zh: 最后，复分析研究的是复数函数的性质。

cues.en: This brings us to applied mathematics.
cues.zh: 这就引出了应用数学。

cues.en: At this point it is probably worth mentioning that everything here is a lot more interrelated than I have drawn.
cues.zh: 这里可能值得一提的是，实际情况中所有这些学科之间的相互关联远比我所画的要复杂得多。

cues.en: In reality this map should look more like a web tying together all the different subjects, but you can only do so much on a two dimensional plane so I have laid them out as best I can.
cues.zh: 实际上，这张图应该更像一张把所有不同学科联系在一起的网，但在二维平面上你只能做到这么多，所以我尽可能地把它们排布出来了。

cues.en: Okay, we will start with physics which uses just about everything on the left hand side to some degree.
cues.zh: 好，我们从物理学开始，它在一定程度上几乎用到了左侧的所有内容。

cues.en: Mathematical and theoretical physics has a very close relationship with pure maths.
cues.zh: 数学物理和理论物理与纯数学有着非常紧密的关系。

cues.en: Mathematics is also used in the other natural sciences with mathematical chemistry and bio mathematics which look at loads of stuff from modelling molecules to evolutionary biology.
cues.zh: 数学也被用于其他自然科学，比如数学化学和生物数学，它们研究从分子建模到进化生物学的大量内容。

cues.en: Mathematics is also used extensively in engineering,
cues.zh: 数学在工程学中也被广泛使用，

cues.en: building things has taken a lot of maths since the Egyptians and Babylonian times.
cues.zh: 自从埃及和巴比伦时代起，建造东西就需要大量的数学。

cues.en: Very complex electrical systems like aeroplanes
cues.zh: 像飞机这样非常复杂的电气系统

cues.en: or the power grid use methods in dynamical systems called control theory.
cues.zh: 或电网，使用的是动力系统中被称为控制理论的方法。

cues.en: Numerical analysis is a mathematical tool commonly used in places where mathematics becomes too complex to solve completely,
cues.zh: 数值分析是一种数学工具，常用于数学变得过于复杂而无法完全求解的场合，

cues.en: so instead use lots of simple approximations
cues.zh: 于是改用大量简单的近似

cues.en: and combine them all together to get good approximate answers.
cues.zh: 再把它们组合起来，得到良好的近似答案。

cues.en: For example if you put a circle inside a square, throw darts at it and then compare the number of darts in the circle and the square portions you can approximate the value of pi,
cues.zh: 例如，如果你在一个正方形里画一个圆，往里面掷飞镖，然后比较落在圆内和正方形内的飞镖数量，就可以近似算出圆周率的值，

cues.en: but in the real world numerical analysis is done on huge computers.
cues.zh: 但在现实世界中，数值分析是在大型计算机上进行的。

cues.en: Game theory looks at what the best choices are given a set of rules and rational players
cues.zh: 博弈论研究的是在给定一套规则和理性参与者的前提下，什么是最佳选择

cues.en: and it is used in economics when the players can be intelligent
cues.zh: 它被用于经济学中，那里的参与者可以是有智能的

cues.en: but not always and other areas like psychology and biology.
cues.zh: 但并非总是如此，也用于心理学和生物学等其他领域。

cues.en: Probability is the study of random events like coin tosses or dice or humans,
cues.zh: 概率论是研究随机事件，比如抛硬币、掷骰子或人的行为，

cues.en: and statistics is the study of large collections of random processes
cues.zh: 而统计学是研究大量随机过程的集合

cues.en: or the organisation and analysis of data.
cues.zh: 或者说数据的组织与分析。

cues.en: This is obviously related to mathematical finance where you want to model financial systems and get an edge to win all those fat stacks.
cues.zh: 这显然与数学金融相关，你想对金融系统建模，从而获得优势去赢下那些大把钞票。

cues.en: Related to this is optimisation where you are trying to calculate the best choice amongst a set of many different options or constraints
cues.zh: 与此相关的是最优化，你要在许多不同选项或约束中计算出最佳选择

cues.en: which you can normally visualise as trying to find the highest or lowest point of a function.
cues.zh: 通常你可以把它想象成寻找一个函数的最高点或最低点。

cues.en: Optimisation problems are second nature to us humans and we do them all the time, trying to get the best value for money or trying to maximise our happiness in some way. Another area that is very deeply related to pure mathematics is computer science and the rules of computer science were actually derived in pure maths and is another example of something that was worked out way before programmable computers were built.
cues.zh: 最优化问题对我们人类来说是第二天性，我们一直在做，想争取最高的性价比，或以某种方式最大化自己的幸福感。另一个与纯数学关系极深的领域是计算机科学，计算机科学的规则实际上源自纯数学，这也是一个早在可编程计算机被造出来之前就被推导出来的例子。

cues.en: Machine learning, the creation of intelligent computer systems uses many areas in mathematics like linear algebra, optimisation, dynamical systems and probability.
cues.zh: 机器学习，即智能计算机系统的创建，用到了数学中的许多领域，比如线性代数、最优化、动力系统和概率论。

cues.en: And finally the theory of cryptography is very important to computation and uses a lot of pure maths like combinatorics and number theory.
cues.zh: 最后，密码学理论对计算非常重要，并且大量运用组合数学和数论等纯数学。

cues.en: So that covers the main sections of pure and applied mathematics,
cues.zh: 以上涵盖了纯数学和应用数学的主要部分，

cues.en: But I can't end without looking at the foundations of mathematics.
cues.zh: 但我不能不看数学的基础就结束。

cues.en: This area tries to work out the properties of mathematics itself and asks what the basis of all the rules of mathematics is.
cues.zh: 这个领域试图弄清数学本身的性质，并追问数学所有规则的根基是什么。

cues.en: Is there a complete set of fundamental rules called axioms
cues.zh: 是否存在一套完整的基本规则，称为公理，

cues.en: which all of mathematics comes from? And can we prove that it is all consistent with itself?
cues.zh: 所有数学都由此而来？我们能否证明它自身是一致的？

cues.en: Mathematical logic, set theory and category theory try to answer this and a famous result in mathematical logic are Godel's incompleteness theorems which for most people means that mathematics does not have a complete and consistent set of axioms,
cues.zh: 数理逻辑、集合论和范畴论试图回答这个问题，而数理逻辑中一个著名的成果是哥德尔不完备定理，对大多数人来说，这意味着数学并不存在一套完整且一致的公理，

cues.en: which means that it is all kind of made up by us humans.
cues.zh: 也就是说，它在某种程度上都是我们人类编造出来的。

cues.en: Which is weird seeing as mathematics explains so much stuff in the universe so well, why would a thing made up by humans be able to do that?
cues.zh: 这很奇怪，因为数学如此出色地解释了宇宙中的许多事物，为什么人类编造出来的东西能做到这一点？

cues.en: That is a deep mystery right there.
cues.zh: 这本身就是一个深奥的谜团。

cues.en: We also have the theory of computation which looks at different models of computing and how efficiently they can solve problems, and contains complexity theory which looks at what is and isn't computable and how much memory and time you would need, which for most interesting problems is an insane amount.
cues.zh: 我们还有计算理论，它研究不同的计算模型以及它们解决问题的效率，其中包含复杂性理论，研究什么可计算、什么不可计算，以及需要多少内存和时间——对大多数有趣的问题来说，那都是天文数字。

cues.en: So that is the map of mathematics.
cues.zh: 这就是数学全景图。

cues.en: Now the thing I have loved most about learning maths is that feeling you get where something that seems so confusing finally clicks in your brain and everything makes sense, like an epiphany moment, kind of like seeing through the matrix.
cues.zh: 而学数学最让我着迷的，就是原本一头雾水的东西突然在脑海中融会贯通的那种感觉，一切瞬间都讲得通了，就像顿悟一样，有点像看穿了 Matrix 的底层代码。

cues.en: In fact, some of my most satisfying intellectual moments have been understanding some part of mathematics and then feeling like I had a glimpse at the fundamental
cues.zh: 事实上，我最感到充实的某些思维高光时刻，就是搞懂了某块数学之后，感觉自己得以窥见

cues.en: nature of the universe in all of its
cues.zh: 宇宙最底层的本质，以及它浑然一体的

cues.en: symmetrical
cues.zh: 对称

cues.en: wonder.
cues.zh: 奇迹。

cues.en: It's great. I love it.
cues.zh: 这种感觉太棒了，我非常喜欢。

cues.en: Making a map of mathematics was the most popular request I got, which I was really happy about because I love maths and it was great to see so much interest in it. So I hope you enjoyed it. Obviously there's only so much I can get into this time frame but hopefully I've done the subject justice and you found it useful.
cues.zh: 制作一张数学地图是我收到呼声最高的选题，这让我特别开心，因为我热爱数学，能看到大家对此充满热情真的太好了。希望大家喜欢这个视频。显然，在有限的时长里我能讲的内容有限，但希望我讲出了这门学科的神韵，并且对你们有所启发。

cues.en: So there will be more videos coming from me soon, here's all the regular things
cues.zh: 我很快会带来更多视频，惯例的那些关注信息就在这里，

cues.en: and it was my pleasure. See you next time.
cues.zh: 能为大家制作这个视频是我的荣幸，我们下期再见。
